comments.author: full stamina gaming
comments.body_html:
I had an issue where this mod wasn’t working for apparently no reason running SPT as normal, no Fika or headless or anything. Headsets showed their vanilla descriptions without the new stats. All other mods working correctly.

My system language is set to English, but I noticed the SPT server had some lines in my native language (which only my keyboard layout is set to). If anyone else has this issue, go to SPT_Data\Server\configs, open locale.json and change the top two variables (gameLocale and serverLocale) to “en”, quotation marks included. Mine were set to “system” and changing them fixed the issue, so now the mod works correctly.

Thanks redlaser42 for this very handy mod. Would it be possible to update the mod so this step isn’t necessary, or perhaps add a small disclaimer somewhere explaining how to correct this issue?
